import json
import socket
import threading
import urllib.error
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

import pytest

from httpkit import HTTPStatusError, fetch_json


class _Server:
    """Serves queued (status, body) responses and records request headers."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.responses = []
        self.requests = []
        owner = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                owner.requests.append(dict(self.headers))
                status, body = owner.responses.pop(0)
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(body)

            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

        self._httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self._httpd.server_address[1]}/data"
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)

    def __enter__(self):
        self._thread.start()
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        self._httpd.shutdown()
        self._httpd.server_close()


@pytest.fixture
def server():
    with _Server() as srv:
        yield srv


def test_returns_decoded_json(server):
    server.responses = [(200, json.dumps({"a": [1, 2]}).encode())]
    assert fetch_json(server.url) == {"a": [1, 2]}


def test_sends_accept_and_user_agent_headers(server):
    server.responses = [(200, b"{}")]
    fetch_json(server.url)
    headers = server.requests[0]
    assert headers["Accept"] == "application/json"
    assert headers["User-Agent"] == "httpkit/1.0"


def test_any_2xx_is_success(server):
    server.responses = [(204, b"null")]
    assert fetch_json(server.url) is None


def test_4xx_raises_without_retry(server):
    server.responses = [(404, b"{}"), (2

00, b"{}")]
    with pytest.raises(HTTPStatusError) as info:
        fetch_json(server.url, retries=3)
    assert info.value.status == 404
    assert info.value.url == server.url
    assert len(server.requests) == 1


def test_5xx_retried_then_succeeds(server):
    server.responses = [(503, b"{}"), (500, b"{}"), (200, b'{"ok": true}')]
    assert fetch_json(server.url, retries=2) == {"ok": True}
    assert len(server.requests) == 3


def test_5xx_exhausts_retries_and_raises_last_status(server):
    server.responses = [(500, b"{}"), (502, b"{}"), (504, b"{}")]
    with pytest.raises(HTTPStatusError) as info:
        fetch_json(server.url, retries=2)
    assert info.value.status == 504
    assert info.value.url == server.url
    assert len(server.requests) == 3


def test_5xx_without_retries_makes_one_attempt(server):
    server.responses = [(500, b"{}"), (200, b"{}")]
    with pytest.raises(HTTPStatusError) as info:
        fetch_json(server.url)
    assert info.value.status == 500
    assert len(server.requests) == 1


def test_invalid_json_raises_value_error(server):
    server.responses = [(200, b"<html>not json</html>")]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        fetch_json(server.url)


def test_negative_retries_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        fetch_json("http://127.0.0.1:1/", retries=-1)


def test_connection_refused_propagates_original_error():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = sock.getsockname()[1]
    # The socket is closed again, so nothing listens on this port.
    with pytest.raises(urllib.error.URLError) as info:
        fetch_json(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/", timeout=1.0)
    assert not isinstance(info.value, HTTPStatusError)


def test_timeout_propagates_original_error(server):
    class _Silent(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            threading.Event().wait(2)

        def log_message(self, *args):
            pass

    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0

.0.1", 0), _Silent)
    httpd.daemon_threads = True
    thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{httpd.server_address[1]}/slow"
        with pytest.raises(socket.timeout):
            fetch_json(url, timeout=0.2)
    finally:
        httpd.shutdown()
        httpd.server_close()
